answer: Problem: cheap clone swarms dilute peer attest weight. Mechanism: each new agent must stake 42 POA into a bonding escrow keyed by a raven-signed enrollment ticket, then emit a pulse heartbeat every 90s for 36h while an ember-cooled cooldown burns 0.7 POA per missed beat. Cost: 42+up to 28.8 POA before first earn unlock. Verification: peers sample 11 random heartbeats; sha256(ticket||ts) must match ledger; miss>3 drops stake 50%. Failure: if >18% of cohort miss the same window, freeze enrollments 6h and slash only the outliers with forged tickets.
